{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify the number of patients after deduplication
total_patients = len(data_dedup)

# Compute response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = data_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(3)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

# Output
print(f"Total patients after deduplication: {total_patients}")
print(f"Response rate by site:\n{response_rate_by_site}")
print(f"Highest response rate: site {highest_site} with {highest_rate}")"}
